Marissa — answers below (summary + artifacts).

1) SOC 2 Type II report period:
- Coverage: 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31 (full SOC 2 Type II audit completed). We can provide a redacted PDF suitable for vendor sharing.

2) Bridge letter:
- We have a standard bridge letter that attests to controls continuity and material changes since the last report; it covers any gap between the last report period end and the next audit. We can customize the letter for BrightBridge and sign it (PDF).

3) Hosting & cross-border transfers:
- Primary customer data for hosted customers is stored in AWS eu-west-2 (London) by default.
- For customers that sign our Private deployment or select regional retention, data can be held in a customer VPC or region (we will note this in the DPA).
- Backups and DR: snapshots are replicated to a secondary region for disaster recovery. For the hosted product, some non‑PII metadata and anonymized telemetry used for performance analytics may be processed in the US.
- Cross-border controls: all data transfers are encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). KMS keys for hosted customer data are region-scoped; for standard hosted customers we manage keys with strict access controls and we can provide information on key rotation and access logs.
- Legal basis: we apply SCCs where required and include a DPA that spells out subprocessors and transfer mechanisms.

4) Recommended artifacts to send (I suggest):
- SOC2-TypeII-Redacted-2024-Redwood.pdf (redacted report)
- Redwood-Bridge-Letter-20260316.pdf (signed, tailored to BrightBridge)
- DPA and SCC references (link or PDF) — include statement on encryption and KMS
- data-flow-eu-us.png (simple diagram showing what is stored in eu-west-2 vs items that may transit to other regions)
- Short memo describing backup retention windows and where backups land

5) ETA:
- Redacted SOC 2 + DPA/SCC links: within 2 business days
- Bridge letter (signed): within 48 hours after the above

If procurement needs an unredacted report for their legal counsel, we'll need an NDA and a secure transfer method (we can provide a watermarked copy on request).

--
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
